en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, fortress-like institutional building with multiple wings and steep, pyramidal-roofed corner towers. The long façade, many windows, and tall central blocks sit behind a line of leafless trees and a fence. In the foreground is an open parade ground or field with scattered pedestrians; on the right stand two uniformed soldiers holding rifles, wearing dark tunics with rows of buttons, tall boots, and pickelhaube-style helmets. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.
